_about: Metrics section: the exact usage.d dashboard and lower logs.
metrics.title: Measurements
metrics.about: Token usage across agent runs. Operational logs and measurements are below.
metrics.compare_hint: Compare with the previous window of the same length. Available for 1, 7 and 30 days.
metrics.compare_off: Comparison is unavailable for 90 days and All.
metrics.refresh_hint: Re-read exact tokens, approximate measurements and lower logs.
metrics.old_server: The top dashboard is unavailable: the server does not support schema 2.
metrics.old_server_hint: Update the kit and restart the panel. The lower logs remain available.
metrics.card.total_hint: The sum of input and output tokens of successful calls. Approximate timing.d values are not included.
metrics.card.in_hint: Input tokens of successful calls from usage.d.
metrics.card.out_hint: Output tokens of successful calls from usage.d.
metrics.card.cache_sub: Part of input, not added to the total
metrics.card.cache_hint: Input tokens served from the provider cache. An unknown value is not treated as zero.
metrics.card.runs_hint: All runs in the window, including runs without model calls.
metrics.card.per_run_hint: Exact tokens divided by the number of runs; approximate values are not included.
metrics.filter.reset_hint: Return to 7 days and clear the filters.
metrics.empty.no_records: No runs with token accounting yet
metrics.empty.no_calls: Runs happened, but there were no model calls
metrics.empty.module_missing: The usage module is not installed
metrics.truncated: There are more rows than fit in the response: only a part is shown. Narrow the filters.
metrics.chart.title: Daily trend
metrics.chart.about: Exact usage.d tokens by day. Approximate timing.d values are shown separately.
metrics.chart.caption: Values by day for the selected window.
metrics.chart.aria: Daily token chart from {from} to {to}: {points} points, {total} in total.
metrics.projects_about: Share, change, runs and the last run by project.
metrics.projects_caption: Exact tokens by project; missing values are at the bottom.
metrics.models_about: Calls, input, output and share by model.
metrics.models_caption: Exact tokens by model; missing values are at the bottom.
metrics.roles_about: Compact chips with the token share; press one to filter.
metrics.providers_about: Only the key state: present, absent or unknown. The key value is never shown.
metrics.providers_caption: The key state is shown in words, without the value or mask.
metrics.approx_note: estimate from timing.d, not included in the exact total
metrics.approx.empty: No approximate records in the window.
metrics.approx_caption: Estimate by project, not included in the exact total.
